reason: My sister in Karachi and my cousins in Dubai send me pieces, and I stock up when I travel, where an embroidered thobe costs me a fraction of $75. Westchase is close enough off the freeway that I might look on a weekend, but nothing is pulling me there in November with no Eid or wedding coming.
objection: At $75 to $80 for crepe, I'd want to feel it first, and I expect it to be thin, a bit see-through or that scratchy synthetic crepe I can get for much less abroad. A 15% opening discount doesn't change that.
would_change_my_mind: Touching the fabric and finding it heavy, opaque and soft, with proper embroidery, right before a family wedding or Eid when I don't have time to get something sent from home.
